method: Each replay is a stratified sample of up to 1,500 eligible finishes from one race edition, chosen at evenly spaced finish-time ranks. Everyone starts together at elapsed time zero because wave and start offsets are not recorded, and each runner moves at a constant speed within each recorded section. Colours compare the current section with that runner's own 5–20 km pace.
